alex: Morning — quick async standup for SDKs / quickstarts / sample apps.

alex: What I did: merged Python quickstart wording updates + added a note about macOS wheels (pip install quirks). Uploaded the small sample to samplekit.

alex: Blockers: sampleapp CI is failing on mac-latest — installs time out or fail building wheels. Can't repro on my local M1. Error snippet from CI: 
```
ERROR: Could not build wheels for protobuf
```

alex: Today: dig into CI logs, try a pip fallback in the Dockerfile, review @maria's JS sample PR, and prep a changelog blurb for the SDK patch.

maria: Thanks — I'll add a `--no-binary=:all:` fallback for protobuf in the sampleapp Dockerfile and push a tiny test cleanup to the PR (#412).
maria: Quick question: do we want the quickstart to default to reading token from $REDWOOD_API_KEY or from a local config file?
jordan: I saw similar flakes — network + wheel builds on mac runners. Two suggestions: add a pip mirror and `--retries 10`, and pin `setuptools`/`wheel` versions early in the Dockerfile.
jordan: Repro command I used inside the action image: 
```
docker run --rm -it ghcr.io/actions/runner:macos-latest bash -c "python -m pip install -r requirements.txt"
```
sam: I'm on call today, can grab the CI logs and re-run that workflow if someone posts the failing job URL. ping @alex
sam: Filed a tracking issue in samplekit for Apple Silicon wheel problems: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/issues/99 :spiral_notepad:

alex: Thanks — if someone can triage the logs I'll prioritize the PR reviews and the changelog. :thumbsup:
